title: Death of Concharis (Khaankhra Sobekhotep) and Merenre II, 1491 BC
summary: CFAH AP-51: Concharis (Khaankhra Sobekhotep) of Dynasty 13 died in 1491 BC, the year of the Exodus; CFAH-6 also places the death of Merenre II then.
description: The Sothis King List gives 700 years from the Dispersion (AP-2) to the death of king #25, Concharis. CFAH-6: "1491 BC is the date of the Exodus in the Ussher-Jones chronology (Jones 2019, 24)."

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 6: The Old and Middle Kingdoms of Egypt," ARJ 18 (2025): 13–60, Argument 2, Table 1 "Anchor Points for early Egyptian history" #51; Argument 2 §D "The Death of Merenre II is Synchronized with the Death of Concharis of D13"
chronologies.note: CFAH-6 Table 1: "Death of Concharis, Khaankhra Sobekhotep"
Jones (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament, 2002) gives no date for this extra-biblical event.
No matching entry found in Ussher's Annals.
